comment: connect [→ dev-toolbar-admin-btn]  to settings, it should be all a big settings page that admins can see more things and manage more then a dev user
resolutionNote: Already satisfied by the recent settings-hub work (PRs #55/#56/#59): DevAdminPanel is now a single panel with Menu/Users/Logs tabs — the Menu tab (toolbar layout/orientation/icon size/role-picker dock) is open to any dev user with no admin secret, Users and Logs are ADMIN_SECRET-gated and show more (dev-user management, universal activity log). The single toolbar gear icon (dev-toolbar-admin-btn) and the greeting menu's "User settings" both open this same panel — there's no separate dev-toolbar-settings-btn anymore.
